A: Workout plans, exercises, and nested configurations.
This is a local FastAPI application that manages persistent domain resources through REST endpoints.
Apply the shared authorization, validation, controlled-error, and transaction conventions specified for the endpoint.

schemas_pseudocode.body: 1. DEFINE class WorkoutPlanResponse. Declare fields or class attributes: created_at, description, id, model_config, name, status, updated_at, user_id.

controller_pseudocode.body: 1. DEFINE routine clone_plan accepting db, current_user, workoutplan_id, payload. Raise the declared controlled errors when a guard fails. Coordinate persistence changes through the surrounding transaction/session. Return the value produced by the implemented branch.

orm_model_pseudocode.body:
1. DEFINE class UserModel. Declare fields or class attributes: __tablename__, id, role, token, username. Enforce the declared uniqueness constraints.
2. DEFINE class WorkoutPlanModel. Declare fields or class attributes: __tablename__, created_at, description, id, is_deleted, name, status, updated_at, user_id.
3. DEFINE class PlanBlockModel. Declare fields or class attributes: __tablename__, created_at, exercise_id, id, notes, plan_id, position, updated_at.
4. DEFINE class PlanBlockSetModel. Declare fields or class attributes: __tablename__, block_id, id, reps, rest_seconds, set_number, target_load_kg.

formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /workout-plans/{workoutplan_id}/clone to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON declared route fields; it shall validate Exercises have unique code, name 2..120, category enum, and active flag, atomically create the resource or relation, be non-idempotent, and return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.
